scoring_justification: The scored artifact is the agent's computed relative energies per Al2O3 unit; the checker compares the reported values to the paper's published values with an absolute tolerance of ±0.3 eV, as recomputing from raw total energies is not required by the output contract.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference relative energies for four Al-sublattice configurations on Ru(0001) and Al(111) substrates, extracted from the paper's Table 1.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction of the reported values for pure-o, pure-t, zig-zag, and stripe patterns on Ru(0001), and pure-o, pure-t, zig-zag on Al(111).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published results, used as gold for verification.

outputs.description: Relative LDA total energies per Al₂O₃ unit for the pure-o, pure-t, zig-zag (2×1), and stripe (3×1) Al-sublattice configurations on Ru(0001) and Al(111). The zig-zag pattern serves as the zero-energy reference.

output_contract.notes: The agent must install Quantum ESPRESSO and fetch the SSSP pseudopotential library. All values are checked against the paper's published energies with an absolute tolerance; the checker also verifies that all reported energies are non‑negative and the zig‑zag structure is lowest.
